selection: Reuse exactly the saved equal-weight momentum constituents; SPY is a single-security portfolio. No rescoring, replacement or inverse-volatility stock weighting
risk_estimate: Sample standard deviation (ddof=1) of the equal-weight mean of current holdings' 63 aligned close-to-close return vectors, multiplied by sqrt(252). This incorporates sample covariance; it is a current-weight risk proxy, not an executed trailing portfolio
exposure_rule: At each original decision close, equity exposure=min(0.75,0.10/estimated annualized full-equity portfolio volatility); remainder in zero-return cash. Execute at original next-session open; fixed shares throughout 21 holding sessions
parameter_rationale: 10% is one round research budget, not fitted to past drawdowns; 63 returns reuse the prior sizing lookback; 75% retains the existing unlevered exposure cap. No search over alternatives
invalid_history: If any constituent lacks 64 valid contiguous same-identity closes through decision or portfolio volatility is zero/invalid, entire portfolio holds cash for that window and records the reason. Never drop constituents or use forward information
cost_and_path: Linearly rescale saved 75%-exposure wealth increments, including both half-cost charges and original unresolved-position weights, by new_exposure/0.75; no change to the saved scenario paths. Cash fallback has zero new trading costs
risk_matched_comparison: Budgeted momentum versus budgeted SPY under the same estimator and budget; report cap frequency, forecast volatility and realized risk because caps and forecast errors prevent exact risk equality
accepted_objective: Separately retain strictly positive compounded net price excess versus FIXED 75/25 scheduled SPY plus no worse than 20% portfolio drawdown. Do not replace the original hurdle with a lower-return de-risked benchmark
dependence_check: Remove the best paired excess-return period from both portfolios, recompute return metrics only; do not stitch a drawdown across the omission
limitations: Same previously examined dates and original source cutoffs, not new temporal validation
Estimated volatility is not a drawdown cap and does not predict event losses or intraday extremes
The cap can prevent either portfolio from reaching the volatility budget
Original missing paths remain scenario estimates; cash fallback does not repair history
Scheduled price returns exclude dividends, cash interest, taxes, overnight gaps between holdings, and realistic variable slippage
No database writes, model fitting, parameter tuning, live publication or orders
